title.narrative: HCFC Phase-out Management Plan (Stage I, 1st Tranche; Polyurethane Foam Sector plan and Refrigeration Servicing)

description.narrative: The Government of the Democratic People#s Republic of Korea has submitted an HPMP including activities to return to compliance with the assistance of the Multilateral Fund. The plan of action for returning to compliance includes speedy implementation of HCFC phase-out activities combined with policy initiatives and awareness activities.
